Key lesson saved:
For OfficeQA Treasury Bulletin trust-fund questions, when comparing total receipts vs total expenditures, the expected two-value “Gini” convention is:

|R−E| / (R+E)

not the textbook two-observation Gini with an extra /2. Also exclude investment rows and classify surplus by receipts > expenditures.
